name: Greece: check of forms and supplied documents

common.check: Trial title, protocol code and EU trial number (if assigned), site, department and principal investigator match the protocol, CTIS and the rest of the package.
Every field the assistant answers is answered; fields that belong to the site, investigator, insurer or another party are left empty, not invented.
No drafting instruction remains; tracked changes, comments and hidden text removed.

Language as requirements.json states (English recommended for K1, M1, M2, N1, P1, R1, S1; insurance certificate Greek or English); no signature unless this document's signature rule requires one (N1 and Phase I declaration: principal investigator; O1: insurer).

CTIS title follows the naming guide and requirements.json (_EL for country-level documents); no obsolete national form from the former Clinical Trials Directive unless current CTR guidance expressly retains it.

GR-N-SITES.check: CTIS Trial Sites structured data complete for every Greek site, matching M1, M2, N1 and the participant documents.
Each site is a public hospital or private clinic with suitable infrastructure.

GR-K1.check: Uses the EudraLex Recruitment and Informed Consent Procedure template version 2.0 (new Part II submissions from 1 September 2026), answered in English unless the user chose Greek.

The yes/no answers for incapacitated adults, minors, impartial witness and emergency match the project's populations and study facts; each 'yes' section is completed, each 'no' section says not applicable.

Member State fields contain the Greek additions in national_fields: in-person paper consent with full dates and signed copy; Greek documents and certified translations; two-parent consent and assent from 10; court-appointed judicial supporter; one- or two-witness and audio/video routes; Article 35 emergency representative list; excluded groups.
Emergency section describes identification, eligibility confirmation, prior-objection check, representative search, enrolment authorisation and documentation.
Audio or video consent recording is described (method, storage, access, privacy, retention, contingency) only where the protocol uses it.
Recruitment routes and first act of recruitment match the recruitment material (GR-K2) and the protocol.

GR-L1-TRANSLATION.check: A valid or certified translation exists for each planned language and each participant document that person needs, based on the approved Greek version (same version and date).
A later translation is planned through the applicable CTIS application route.

GR-M1.check: One CV per principal investigator and Greek site, stating relevant qualifications, experience and current GCP training.
No signature added by habit; signed only where the template instructions or the National Ethics Committee explicitly require it.

GR-M2-DOI.check: One declaration of interest per principal investigator and Greek site, completed by the investigator (EU template or similar, normally English).

GR-M-PHASE1-DECL.check: Signed principal-investigator declaration per Greek site that the site and research team meet Article 7 of Government Gazette B 4131/2016; same version as the one in GR-N-PHASE1.

GR-M-ALS.check: Current Advanced Life Support certificates for the principal investigator and every relevant research-team member, per Greek site.

GR-N1.check: One form per Greek site in Suitability of the Facilities, specific to this protocol (facilities, equipment, procedures, human resources).
Signed by the principal investigator at submission; the draft leaves the signature block empty.
For Phase I, consistent with the Article 7 declaration and the equipment and emergency-capability evidence (GR-N-PHASE1).

GR-N-PHASE1.check: Principal-investigator Article 7 declaration plus evidence of appropriate equipment and emergency capability for the site.

GR-O1.check: Certificate executed by the insurer (not a blank form), in Greek or English, identifying the trial and the coverage.
Contains the required pregnancy clause and complies with JMD G5a/59676 and the CTR; every participant and pregnancy form describes injury compensation consistently with it.

GR-P1.check: Each benefit's type, amount or value, payment method and rationale documented.
Only actual expenses, directly related lost income and reasonable compensation for time or burden; no incentive to enrol or remain (National Ethics Committee, 22 July 2026).
Specific limits applied for minors, incapacitated participants and pregnant or breastfeeding participants.
Amounts and conditions identical in every Greek participant document; no trial-specific cost charged to participants or their insurers.

GR-P2.check: Applicable annexes of Government Gazette B 230/22.01.2026 (per-participant fee analysis, project-team list, project budget), unsigned; no signed sponsor–PI financial agreement uploaded.
Consistent with P1 and the participant documents.

GR-R1.check: EudraLex GDPR compliance statement covering Regulation (EU) 2016/679 and any transfer of personal data to third countries; no Greek national statement added (not required).
Sponsor details match the CTIS application; participant privacy sections are consistent with it.

GR-S1.check: New and archive sample sections match the protocol and sample plan; at least one is completed.
Analysis, storage, duration, access, coding and transfers match the Greek participant documents and R1.
Future use answered consistently with the separate Greek optional-use form; section 5 states the Greek further-use rule (similar scientific purpose, competent-authority approval).
